inventory.name: loading content attribute on <video> and <audio> (enumerated lazy loading attribute; states Eager | Lazy; missing-value and invalid-value defaults Eager)
HTMLMediaElement.loading IDL attribute ([CEReactions] attribute DOMString loading — reflects the content attribute on both HTMLVideoElement and HTMLAudioElement)

Lazy-state algorithmic behavior: precedence over preload; poster image deferral; autoplay/playback deferral; Lazy-to-Eager resumption steps; audio-without-controls does not lazy load; lazy loading disabled when scripting is disabled

errors.rationale: HTML enumerated attributes have no exception surface: an invalid or missing value falls back to the Eager default per the lazy loading attributes definition (WHATWG HTML, fetched 2026-08-16), which the Syntax section states.
A [CEReactions] DOMString reflection does not throw; assigning an unknown value simply reflects a string whose state falls back to Eager (WHATWG HTML lazy loading attributes, fetched 2026-08-16).

securityPrivacy.rationale: The IDL reflection adds no security surface beyond the content attribute's own behavior; the scripting-disabled anti-cloaking rule documented in the Syntax section belongs to the attribute states (WHATWG HTML, fetched 2026-08-16).

errors.rationale: The Lazy-state algorithms (deferral, resumption steps) define no failure or exception path; they only defer and later resume fetching/playback (WHATWG HTML media loading algorithms, fetched 2026-08-16).
